title: backlog.py intake files deterministic candidates once, by fingerprint
goal: _tools/bl_intake.py holds a detector registry; python3 _tools/backlog.py intake prints each detector's candidates (kind, title, goal, repro, links with fingerprint <12 hex>) without writing, --file writes each new one as a draft item outside any sprint, and a candidate whose fingerprint an open item's links already carry is skipped; intake --status FINGERPRINT exits 1 while a detector still reports it, which is the repro of every bug intake files; the same inputs print the same lines in any clone; no model call
